mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 6-month moving average indicates a strengthening economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 4% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to increased borrowing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts above its 3-month moving average, combined with a rise in consumer spending, indicates a strengthening economy and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of increasing housing starts and consumer spending (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below its 6-month moving average indicates a weakening economy, leading to decreased demand for raw materials and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in consumer spending above its 3-month moving average, combined with a rise in GDP, indicates a strengthening economy and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of increasing consumer spending and GDP (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in payroll employment above its 6-month moving average indicates a strengthening labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of increasing payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).
